notes: Specialty product shape as in specialty/honda.json. Prices are as seen on the cited page/date. Avoids products already in aftermarket/specialty/*.json (Pro Circuit engine parts, Twisted Development ECU items, Ride Engineering clamps/link listing, REP springs, Hot Cams) except where a media test adds a result. Product pages for Pro Circuit, Race Tech, Enzo, MX-Tech, Factory Connection, Twisted Development and Yoshimura were unreachable or had no searchable RM-Z fitment from this environment.

variants: CNC titanium front mounts, aluminum top mounts, titanium bolt; 395 g listed

products.claimed_result: Maker claims plusher feel, better front traction; AMA Limited/Stock legal.

variants: CNC titanium front mounts, aluminum top mounts
products.what_it_changes: Replaces stock engine mounts to add chassis compliance.
products.claimed_result: Maker claims plusher feel and better front traction; MXA 2025 RM-Z250 test cites these mounts for the stiff frame.

products.product: Fork and shock re-valve with Gold Valves and lighter springs (RM-Z250)
variants: Valved for tester spec; lighter springs front and rear
products.what_it_changes: Damping and spring rates on KYB fork and shock.
products.claimed_result: Tester: much more front-end comfort, calmer chassis, kept bottoming resistance.

products.product: Showa coil fork and BFRC shock re-valve with Gold Valves and softer springs (RM-Z450)
variants: Swapmoto bike: valved to test-rider spec, softer fork and shock springs
Keefer loan bike: valved for an intermediate rider, stiffer springs
products.what_it_changes: Fork and BFRC shock damping and springs.
products.claimed_result: Testers: shock gains rebound control and stops lifting; harshness in rough terrain largely gone; head shake reduced but not eliminated.

products.product: Head porting, five-angle valve job and matched Vortex ECU map (RM-Z250)
variants: About $1500 for head work plus ECU per tester
products.claimed_result: Tuner dyno: about 10% more power through mid and top; tester felt broader, easier power.

products.what_it_changes: Lowers the rear and changes shock leverage.
products.claimed_result: Tester: rear settles on decel, less knifing on corner entry; run 107mm sag with fork height 4-5mm.

variants: MXA ran it for several seasons
products.what_it_changes: Lowers the rear and firms the initial shock stroke.
products.claimed_result: MXA recommends a 1mm-longer link with 105mm race sag.

variants: Tester weight 6 lb 11 oz vs about 9 lb stock
products.what_it_changes: Exhaust; about 3 lb lighter than stock.
products.claimed_result: Tester: cleaner, longer pull and better over-rev; no extra third-gear lugging.
